name: Randomized Littlestone Dimension of Addressing
proof: Restrict here to $n=2^r$ with all r-bit words present, so $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor=\log_2n=r$. Write d for $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$. The class has exactly $2^d$ concepts, so every shattered tree has expected random-branch depth at most d by the entropy bound. Querying the d address coordinates gives a complete shattered tree of depth d, hence randomized value d/2.
details: Scope: complete-code subfamily $n=2^r$, $r\ge1$. The displayed formula is not asserted for arbitrary injective encodings at other n.
